tools.name: pi_project_memory_status
tools.description:
Show pi-muninn's project-memory runtime status for a workspace: enabled/disabled, scope, and continuity db state.

Guidelines:
- Use when continuity tools report project memory disabled and you need to verify runtime scope.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the target project root. Defaults to the project Claude Code is currently working in.

tools.name: pi_project_memory_enable
tools.description:
Enable or disable pi-muninn project-scoped memory for a workspace. Creates .agent/memory/ and its db on first enable.

Guidelines:
- Use when continuity DB tools fail because project memory is disabled.
- After enabling, continue with continuity_write.
- For durable decisions/preferences, also call memory_save using payload targets (projectContent/generalContent) so memory state stays explicit and queryable.

enabled.description: Set true to enable project memory (default), false to disable.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the target project root. Defaults to the project Claude Code is currently working in.

tools.name: pi_continuity_write
tools.description:
Persist one continuity entry (plan, decision, discovery, progress note, or outcome) for a workspace.

Guidelines:
- Use this as the default continuity write path.
- Write continuity as work progresses (do not batch everything only at request end).
- When multiple artifacts/decisions are involved, write separate semantic entries per artifact/decision.
- For DECISIONS/DISCOVERIES/OUTCOMES, include sourceRefs evidence so provenance is explicit.
- After storing high-signal decisions/preferences, also call pi_memory_save with projectContent for project-specific facts, generalContent for reusable preferences, or both.
- Avoid command-output/log report prose in semantic entries; low-signal report-style rows are skipped.
- If this fails, treat continuity persistence as failed and report explicitly.
- Do not retry with different section/provenance/content when failure indicates runtime indexing/DB errors; escalate the runtime issue instead.

section.description: Continuity section this entry belongs to.

certainty.description: Confidence in this entry, if known.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp for this entry (defaults to now).

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the target project root. Defaults to the project Claude Code is currently working in.

tools.name: pi_continuity_query
tools.description:
Query cross-user project continuity entries (plans, decisions, progress, discoveries, outcomes) for a workspace.

Guidelines:
- Use this as the default continuity retrieval tool.
- Project-enabled contract: results come from the cross-user project continuity aggregate with user attribution.
- Memory and continuity are split: use this for continuity rows, pi_memory_search for memories.
- Use bounded filters and limits to keep continuity retrieval focused and cheap.

query.description: Free-text query matched against continuity content.

section.description: Restrict results to one continuity section.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the target project root. Defaults to the project Claude Code is currently working in.

tools.name: pi_memory_search
tools.description:
Search stored memories by semantic similarity across past conversations, decisions, and context.

Guidelines:
- Use when the user asks about past decisions, previous conversations, or 'what did we decide about X'.
- Filter by project to narrow results to a specific codebase.
- Returns ranked results with similarity scores — higher is more relevant.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the target project root. Defaults to the project Claude Code is currently working in.

tools.name: pi_memory_save
tools.description:
Save a piece of information to persistent memory. Set projectContent for project-specific facts, generalContent for reusable preferences, or both.

Guidelines:
- Use when the user says 'remember this' or when an important decision is made.
- Include enough context in the content for it to be useful later.
- Use projectContent for member-local project memory wording.
- Use generalContent for reusable cross-project memory wording.
- Provide both projectContent and generalContent when both targets should be executed in one call.
- At least one of projectContent/generalContent must be non-empty or the call is blocked.

projectContent.description: Project-specific content to remember (this workspace only).

generalContent.description: Reusable content to remember across all projects.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the target project root. Defaults to the project Claude Code is currently working in.
